### Current Project Overview
Your repository ([ezzhishan-cyber/my-project](https://github.com/ezzhishan-cyber/my-project/blob/main/README.md)) is configured with the **OlympTrade 5-Minute AI Trading Agent & Discipline To-Do System**:

1. **Interactive Web Dashboard (`src/`)**:
   - **5-Minute Real-Time Charting Engine**: Interactive candlesticks with EMA (9/21/50), Bollinger Bands (20, 2σ), RSI (14 & 7), MACD, and Stochastic indicators.

2. **Python Bot Suite (`python_bot/`)**:
   - [confluence_strategy.py](https://github.com/ezzhishan-cyber/my-project/blob/main/python_bot/confluence_strategy.py): Multi-indicator confluence calculation engine.
   - [backtester.py](https://github.com/ezzhishan-cyber/my-project/blob/main/python_bot/backtester.py): Backtesting engine for 5-minute fixed-time expiration trades.
   - [olymptrade_client.py](https://github.com/ezzhishan-cyber/my-project/blob/main/python_bot/olymptrade_client.py) & [run_agent.py](https://github.com/ezzhishan-cyber/my-project/blob/main/python_bot/run_agent.py): Asynchronous WebSocket connection and execution agent.
